title: Restriction of a union with a disjoint subset
statement: Let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates, let $T\subseteq J$, and let $U$ be a finite set of ambient coordinates contained in the complement of $J$. Then restricting the union of the ambient copy of $T$ with $U$ back to $J$ gives $T$.
